<!-- Source page: Get In Touch -->

This article extends [nixos.org/community](https://nixos.org/community.html) for how to get in touch and lists additional platforms to meet community members.

See the <a href="Nix_Community" class="wikilink" title="Nix Community">Nix Community</a> article to learn more about who we are.

## Official Spaces

These are spaces are moderated by the [NixOS Moderation Team](https://nixos.org/community/teams/moderation/)

### Events

See the <a href="Events" class="wikilink" title="Events">Events</a> page for past and upcoming events!

See also the [NixCon Fediverse](https://conf.tube/accounts/nixcon/video-channels) or [YouTube](https://www.youtube.com/results?search_query=nixos) sites for past NixCon recordings.

### Github

- [NixOS](https://github.com/NixOS/) - Official Nix Org
  - Contribute packages on [nixpkgs](https://github.com/NixOS/nixpkgs)
  - Develop the [nix language](https://github.com/NixOS/nix)
  - Participate in [RFC discussions](https://github.com/NixOS/rfcs)
- [Nix-Community](https://github.com/nix-community/) - Explore community projects!

### Forums

- [Official Discourse forum](https://discourse.nixos.org/) - Ask for help here! (\>14k users)

### Chats

#### Matrix

The official [NixOS Community Space](https://matrix.to/#/#community:nixos.org) has rooms on many Nix topics.

- [\#users:nixos.org](https://matrix.to/#/#users:nixos.org) - Main Room (\>4k members)
- [\#wiki:nixos.org](https://matrix.to/#/#wiki:nixos.org) - Wiki Contributors (\>200 members)

Note: If your client doesn't support [Matrix Spaces](https://matrix.org/ecosystem/clients/), see the <a href="MatrixRooms" class="wikilink" title="MatrixRooms">MatrixRooms</a> page for list of all rooms.

#### Zulip

- [NixOS Governance Discussion](https://nixpkgs.zulipchat.com/#recent) - Ongoing NixOS Governance discussions occurring here. Requires contribution to nixpkgs to participate.

#### Jitsi

- [OfficeHours](https://meet.jit.si/NixOfficeHours) - Weekly Nix Office Hours (1600-2000 UTC Fridays, more times as mentors are available)

## Officially Maintained

*Unmoderated* spaces maintained by the moderation team.

#### [Mastodon](https://chaos.social/@nixos_org)

#### [LinkedIn](https://www.linkedin.com/company/nixos-foundation/)

## Unofficial Spaces

Spaces maintained by members of the community.

### Forums

- [r/NixOS](https://www.reddit.com/r/NixOS/) on Reddit (\>35k members)

<!-- -->

- [!nix@programming.dev](https://programming.dev/c/nix) on Lemmy (\>1k subscribers)

<!-- -->

- [Stack Overflow](https://stackoverflow.com/questions/tagged/nixos+or+nix+or+nixops+or+nixpkgs) (\>1k questions answered)
- [Unix & Linux Stack Exchange](https://unix.stackexchange.com/questions/tagged/nixos+or+nix+or+nixops+or+nixpkgs) (\>400 questions answered)

### Chats

#### Discord

- [Nix/NixOS (Unoffical)](https://discord.gg/Vs4SWzFnWz) (\>12k members)
- [Nix/NixOS Community](https://discord.gg/zaz3H6UsYk) (\>500 members)[^1]

#### IRC

Previously hosted on Freenode but was switched to libera.chat. There are [public logs](https://logs.nix.samueldr.com/) from the Freenode versions of these channels.

- [\#nixos](ircs://irc.libera.chat:6697/nixos) - General NixOS and Nix help
- [\#nix-darwin](ircs://irc.libera.chat:6697/nixos/nix-darwin) - Nix on macOS
- [\#nixos-chat](ircs://irc.libera.chat:6697/nixos-chat) - Informal chit-chat channel when going off-topic in the main channel
- [\#nixos-dev](ircs://irc.libera.chat:6697/nixos-dev) - Nix and NixOS development (#nixos for questions)
- [\#nixos-emacs](ircs://irc.libera.chat:6697/nixos-emacs) - Nix Emacs discussion

##### Regional IRC

- [\#nixos-cs](ircs://irc.libera.chat:6697/nixos-cs) - Czech and Slovak NixOS community
- [\#nixos-fr](ircs://irc.libera.chat:6697/nixos-fr) - French NixOS community
- [\#nixos](irc://irc.hackint.org/nixos) - German NixOS community on [hackint.org](https://hackint.org) ([webchat](https://webirc.hackint.org))

#### Regional Telegram

There are some regional Telegram groups dedicated to NixOS:

- [@NixOS_zhcn](https://t.me/NixOS_zhcn) - Chinese, English
- [@ru_nixos](https://t.me/ru_nixos) - Russian, English
- [@nixos_en](https://t.me/nixos_en) - English
- [@nixosbr](https://t.me/nixosbr) - Portuguese
- [@nixosita](https://t.me/nixosita) - Italian

#### Signal

- [Nix / NixOS](https://signal.group/#CjQKIOJMxvGvEgIsYgjVrhCDDvNaMWg5u6QvbxTZVvFLXxP9EhCZ62ghyNi1mUZJIinAlpqi) - General nix and NixOS signal group
